title: Privacy in this prototype
intro: This page describes the current prototype. A privacy policy for a public service has not yet been established.

sections.heading: Example discussions
paragraphs: Discussions marked as examples use illustrative contributions included with the website. Text entered through the issue form is kept separate from these examples.

sections.heading: Your issue input
paragraphs: In the development demo, the form is labelled “Demo”. Your text and its access receipt are saved in this browser tab’s session storage. The demo does not send your contribution to a server or provide lasting storage.

Outside demo mode, submitting the form makes your text publicly searchable. OpinionSearch stores your original words and uses an embedding to find related text and a model to estimate its sentiment. Sentiment describes tone, not agreement with a topic. Submissions previously saved as private remain private unless explicitly made public.

sections.heading: Your access receipt
paragraphs: The website keeps an access receipt in this browser tab’s session storage, with browser history state as a fallback. It uses the receipt to reopen your saved-text page without an account. The receipt is not included in the page address and does not make publicly submitted text private.

Closing the tab or losing the receipt can prevent access to your contribution; it does not delete the text stored on the server. This prototype has no automatic expiry, account recovery, or contribution editing or deletion in its interface.
